item.title: Belize Coast Guard Launches New Patrol Base on Caye Caulker
item.description: A major step forward for maritime security and community development unfolded on Caye Caulker today, as the Belize Coast Guard officially launched its new patrol base on the island. We join Karil Wallace for that story.
